# SaaS Multisite Platform

> Open-source multi-brand CMS / multisite SaaS by Mestryx (working name `mestryx-platform`): TypeScript monorepo with Hono API, Vite/React admin, TanStack Start SSR storefronts, Drizzle, Better Auth, shared UI in `packages/ui`. Chat with the operator is French; all durable artifacts are English.

## Root

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, hosts, stack summary
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent guide — architecture rules, key docs map
- [GAMEPLAN.md](GAMEPLAN.md): Delivery game plan
- [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md): Product vision and positioning
